274950145.description:
Cross
Writing Instrument Lot - 4 Pieces
Gold and Silver Toned, Vintage
A collection of four vintage Cross writing instruments, representing the classic American craftsmanship of the A.T. Cross Company. These pens feature the iconic slim silhouette and conical tops that have defined the brand's aesthetic for decades. This lot includes two distinct pairs in gold and silver-toned finishes, providing a range of styles for collectors or daily use.
Items Included:
Gold-toned ballpoint pen with vertical linear engine-turned texture and personalized script engraving, housed in a clear display case.
Silver-toned chrome ballpoint pen with a smooth polished finish and signature pocket clip, housed in a clear display case.
Gold-toned ballpoint pen featuring a "Hostess" heart tag, housed in a black presentation box.
Silver-toned chrome ballpoint pen with a sleek, minimalist finish, housed in a black presentation box.
One additional Cross ballpoint pen refill included.
Condition:
The metal bodies of all four pens exhibit signs of use, including visible surface scratches and scuffs, which are more prominent on the chrome finishes. One gold-toned pen features a personalized script engraving. The internal twist mechanisms are intact, though the pens have not been tested for ink flow or writing functionality. The display cases show moderate shelf wear, including surface scuffing and light scratches to the clear plastic components.

275229269.description:
Cross
Classic Century Pen and Pencil Set
Polished Chrome Finish, Made in USA
This Cross Classic Century writing set represents the brand's most enduring design legacy, characterized by a slender profile and the signature conical top that has defined professional stationery for decades. Manufactured in the USA, these instruments are crafted with precision and finished in a high-luster chrome that offers a timeless, sophisticated aesthetic suitable for executive use or collectors of fine writing tools.
Set includes one twist-action ballpoint pen and one mechanical pencil
Lustrous chrome finish with fine incised vertical line detailing
Features the iconic slim silhouette and black conical cap accents
Original gray presentation case with plush lining and manufacturer badge
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. The chrome barrels remain bright with minimal surface scratching or pocket wear. Both instruments retain their original clips with crisp Cross branding. Mechanical pencil lead is present and functional as shown. The presentation box is structurally sound with minor external storage marks.

274595427.description:
Enter The Earth / Making Memories
Natural Mineral and Fossil Specimen Collection
Geology Study Lot, Late 20th to Early 21st Century
This comprehensive geological collection features a diverse array of natural mineral specimens, fossils, and hand-carved gemstones. The lot is anchored by a 18-compartment organizer containing various rough stones including rose quartz, amethyst, jasper, and apatite, accompanied by a descriptive insert regarding Coprolite (fossilized dung). Complementing the boxed set are several larger individual display pieces and professional carvings from international sources.
Polished Pyrite sphere with "Made in Peru" label featuring natural vuggy texture
Polished Orthoceras cephalopod fossil specimen in black matrix
Amethyst geode with iridescent gold-tone titanium-treated coating
Four hand-carved stone animal figurines: Kambaba, Picture Jasper (Oregon), and Tigereye (South Africa)
Clear plastic organizer box with approximately 18 varieties of rough and tumbled mineral specimens
Condition:
Very good overall condition. Mineral specimens are in their natural rough or polished states as intended. The pyrite sphere and geode are intact with no structural cracks. The carved animals are housed in original protective plastic cases; cases show minor surface scuffing but remain functional. The main organizer box is complete and latches securely, though the lid shows typical light storage wear.
